one_line: Nineteenth-century Bengali poet-dramatist who fused European forms with Bengali epic and lived between Calcutta, Madras and Europe.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s to early 40s, medium height, slightly broad-shouldered with a scholar’s frame rather than a soldier’s.
appearance.face: Oval face with a high forehead, light-brown Bengali complexion, neatly trimmed sideburns joining a short moustache, small rounded nose, expressive dark eyes; default expression is intense yet weary, with a faint half-smile hinting at irony and inner conflict.
appearance.hair: Thick, slightly wavy black hair kept short and combed back from the forehead with a subtle side part; no headwear, hairline clean with a few loose strands near the temples.
appearance.costume: A mid-19th century anglicised Bengali gentleman’s dress: long dark navy wool frock coat reaching mid-thigh with narrow lapels and simple brass buttons, worn over a high-collared plain white cotton shirt and a soft light-grey cravat tied neatly at the throat; slim straight black cotton trousers typical of colonial Calcutta professionals; polished dark brown leather ankle boots; around his shoulders and sometimes draped over one forearm, a fine off-white Bengali cotton shawl with a thin maroon border, subtly patterned with small repeating motifs, hinting at his Bengali roots amidst his Westernised attire.
appearance.signature: A slightly worn dark brown leather-bound manuscript notebook held in one hand, its edges stuffed with loose folded pages, and a simple metal-nib fountain pen tucked between his fingers as if always ready to write.

ref_desc: Michael Madhusudan Dutt is a mid-19th century Bengali gentleman with wavy black hair combed back, oval light-brown face with moustache and sideburns, wearing a navy frock coat, white shirt, black trousers, off-white maroon-bordered shawl, and carrying a worn brown manuscript notebook with a pen.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Michael Madhusudan Dutt as a mid-19th century Bengali poet-scholar: mid-30s, medium build, light-brown Bengali complexion, oval face with high forehead, expressive dark eyes, neatly trimmed moustache and sideburns, and thick wavy black hair short and combed back with a subtle side part and a few loose temple strands. Dress him in a dark navy wool frock coat reaching mid-thigh with narrow lapels and simple brass buttons, worn over a high-collared plain white cotton shirt and a soft light-grey cravat, paired with slim straight black cotton trousers and polished dark brown leather ankle boots. Drape a fine off-white Bengali cotton shawl with a thin maroon border and subtle small motifs over his shoulders, sometimes gathered over one forearm, adding a gentle flowing line. In his hand, place a slightly worn dark brown leather-bound manuscript notebook bulging with loose folded pages, with a simple metal-nib fountain pen tucked between his fingers, posed as if pausing mid-thought. Keep the colour palette to navy blue, off-white, black, dark brown and maroon, and show him from multiple angles to emphasise consistent face, hair, costume details and his ever-present notebook and pen in a dignified, historically grounded anime aesthetic.
